quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on visualizing shots rather than aiming for pins
quotes.excerpt: Visualize an area and let the ball roll to it.
quotes.quote: I told them to visualize a spot, don't hit it to the pin. If you start trying to hit it to the pin, you're going to hit that mug down there. Visualize an area and let the ball roll to it.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on the evolution of his Li-Ning shoe brand
quotes.excerpt: When I first came in I just wanted to make a fashion shoe.
quotes.quote: When I first came in I just wanted to make a fashion shoe and I had people in the brand who were like, we can't make it performance. It won't perform the way we need it to. And so we worked very hard to make sure that we made something that looked good and felt good and performed the way we needed it to.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on the importance of listening to his fan base
quotes.excerpt: You have to listen to your fan base and so we have tried to do that.
quotes.quote: We grew, we listened, we learned. We started at a certain place and then we had evolution. And so as a brand to be standing here 12 years later, you have to listen to your fan base and so we have tried to do that along the journey.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on his partnership with Mr. Li-Ning
quotes.excerpt: To be able to build a partnership with Mr. Li-Ning and take myself, a kid from Chicago.
quotes.quote: To be able to build a partnership with Mr. Li-Ning and take myself, a kid from Chicago, Illinois, and bring me global and kind of open the world up for me, and that's the reason that we're still here today.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on the aesthetic appeal of square-faced watches
quotes.excerpt: Square faces to me brings that picture of that watch to life.
quotes.quote: You know how you put a picture in a frame, it brings it to life. And so square faces to me brings that picture of that watch to life. So I love this Rolex.
